description: This PHP source file defines the class SAML2AuthenticateUser, which extends SugarAuthenticateUser to handle user authentication via SAML2 in the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for authenticating a user and loading the user session upon login.

classes.name: SAML2AuthenticateUser
classes.description: A class extending SugarAuthenticateUser, implementing SAML2-based user authentication logic.

methods.name: authenticateUser
methods.description: Performs authentication of a user based on session data and user details, potentially returning the user ID if successful.

methods.name: loadUserOnLogin
methods.description: Handles the login process for a user, authenticating and setting up the user session.
